title: JSON contract interop playbook and smoke probe for streaming + toolcalls
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a lightweight playbook and accompanying smoke test harness that verifies cross-version and cross-runtime compatibility for JSON mode enforcement when streaming responses and interleaving tool/function calls. This ticket focuses on end-to-end behaviors (partial JSON fragments, sentinel detection, tool-call boundaries), constrained-decoding parameter permutations, and compatibility regressions that break downstream structured parsers. Deliverables: 1) A concise test matrix covering streaming partial payloads + toolcall interleaving across 3 model families; 2) A reusable harness that runs 30 smoke scenarios with pass/fail metrics; 3) A playbook with runbook steps for triage and rollback if structural contract regressions are detected in production. Scope explicitly excludes full fuzz-suite generation and long-tail model quantization experiments which will be handled in follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Smoke harness executes 30 scenarios across streaming and non-streaming modes with clear pass/fail signals
Detection of malformed-sentinel or broken-interleaving errors with telemetry event emitted (structured_output.contract_violation)
Regression thresholds defined: >1% failing scenarios on production traffic must trigger alert and create ENG ticket
Playbook documents triage steps, recommended mitigations (constrained-decoder backoff, model-variant fallback), and rollback criteria
test_matrix: Scenario A: Streaming partial JSON with KV-cache enabled; token-level interruptions simulated; expect graceful partial-recovery and sentinel closure
Scenario B: Interleaved tool call where tool returns structured payload mid-stream; decoder must emit toolcall token and structured fragment intact
Scenario C: Constrained decoder strict=true vs strict=soft permutations against same prompt; log divergence and fallback behavior
Scenario D: Model downgrade path: large model -> quantized variant; verify JSON schema preserved and differences logged
Scenario E: Timeout and partial-truncation handling; ensure decoder emits 'incomplete' sentinel and downstream parser can safely abort
telemetry_and_metrics: Emit structured_output.contract_violation with tags: model, runtime, route, schema_id, decoder_mode
Dashboard: structured-output/smoke/ENG-743210 showing scenario pass rates and recent regressions
runbook: Step 0: If smoke harness fails >3 scenarios in CI, block rollout and open a hotfix branch
Step 1: Reproduce failure locally with same model/version and runtime flags; collect transcript and token-level trace
Step 2: Attempt constrained-decoder backoff (relax max_structured_length or enable soft_delimiters) and re-run
Step 3: If still failing, switch routing policy to stable-model-variant and patch runtime gating to enforce sentinel normalization
Step 4: Post-mortem: add new smoke scenario that captures the regressions and pin to release notes
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Streaming partial JSON plus toolcall interleaving can produce ambiguous token sequences that strict decoders reject. Mitigation: add sentinel-normalizer and primary/secondary schema validation pass to allow graceful degradation.
Risk: Cross-model behavioral drift (different probability mass over sentinel tokens). Mitigation: include model-variant baselines and tune constrained-decoder sampling temperature for parity tests.
Risk: Telemetry volume spike. Mitigation: sample at 1% in high-traffic routes and increase sampling for failing scenarios only.
